# **Shattered Realms is an immersive RPG adventure modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric) that transforms your world into a living fantasy epic.**

**Choose your path — become a master Wizard, a righteous Paladin, a cunning Rogue, a deadly Archer, or a feared Death Knight. Level up your class, equip powerful jewelry and artifacts, and master arcane spells as you explore a world shattered across dimensions.**

**🗺️ Explore overhauled dungeons, taverns, graveyards, and ancient structures — Dungeons Arise, Yung's Better series, Repurposed Structures, and more.**

**🐉 Fight dragons, mythical creatures, and mutant monsters with Ice and Fire, Naturalist, and Mutant Monsters.**

**✨ Descend into new dimensions — the Aether, Twilight Forest, a revamped Nether and End, and the terrifying Deeper Dark.**

**⚔️ Gear up with Accessories, Immersive Armors, Soullike Weaponry, Jewelry, Artifacts, and hundreds of new items.**

**🎯 Quest through Odyssey Quests, discover loot with Loot N Explore, and fast travel with Waystones.**

**🎧 Immerse yourself with Ambient Sounds, Sound Physics Remastered, and proximity Voice Chat.
Fully optimized with Sodium + Iris for beautiful shader support without the lag.**


_Questions, suggestions, or feedback? Join my Discord and let me know — I am always happy to help and improve the pack!_ 👉 https://discord.gg/g8XJG9hdPJ
